Ground textures (2k, resized/renamed for Genesis Valley):
  T_Ground_Grass      <- leafy_grass
  T_Ground_Meadow     <- forrest_ground_01 (lighter grade)
  T_Ground_ForestFloor<- brown_mud_leaves_01

  T_Ground_Cliff      <- aerial_rocks_02
  T_Ground_Riverbank  <- river_small_rocks
  T_Ground_Soil       <- muddy_tracks
